config_aparencia_voltar_padrao_desc: resets only reading, text size and theme colour. It does not touch Theme, Background, Font or Panels
config_aparencia_tema_desc: light, dark or the system one
config_aparencia_tema_desc_web: light, dark or the system one. Desktop: the wallpaper's colours, when the machine can read it
config_aparencia_cor_tema_desc: accent and background tint — one value per mode (dark/light)
config_aparencia_cor_tema_modo_desc: which of the two modes you are editing below; the Theme above picks which one is in use
config_aparencia_tinta_desc: tints the neutral backgrounds with this colour
config_aparencia_forca_cor_desc: how heavily the tint sits on the backgrounds: 5 barely shows, 100 covers
config_aparencia_cor_texto_desc: letters follow the wallpaper or stick to the app colors
config_aparencia_cor_texto_desktop_aria: Text color coming from the wallpaper
config_aparencia_fundo_desc: texture, glow or your own image — kept only on this device — or, in the installed app, the desktop itself behind the window
config_aparencia_papel_parede_desc: leave the window see-through, or copy the photo into the app and get real glass
config_aparencia_desfoque_desc: how blurred the photo behind the conversation gets — helps text readability
config_aparencia_desfoque_hint: The blur here is your system's, not the app's — see shell/README.md.
config_aparencia_liquid_desc: refraction and blur on the side panels — pretty, but CPU-heavy while any session is working
config_aparencia_liquid_off_aria: Panels with plain frosted glass, no refraction
config_aparencia_filtro_vidro_desc: the panels' backdrop-filter — only the tint remains when off; it is what costs CPU, and on the Window background there is nothing to blur
config_aparencia_filtro_vidro_off_aria: No blur behind the panels, tint only — saves CPU
config_aparencia_motivo_tema_desktop: Desktop: no wallpaper read from this machine, or it could not be read just now
config_aparencia_motivo_fundo_desktop: Desktop: only in the installed app
config_aparencia_motivo_cor_tema: With Theme = Desktop the colors come from the wallpaper.
config_aparencia_chamadas_desc: how a command that ran or a file that was read/edited appears in the chat: two lines with the output below, or one line with the argument in a chip
config_aparencia_tarefas_desc: draws the agent tasks as a progress block at the end of the conversation, with the current step highlighted, instead of loose tool lines
config_aparencia_pensamento_tools_desc: when the agent uses a tool while it is still thinking, the call sits inside the collapsed reasoning block. Nothing: always in sight. Search only: hides just reads and searches. Everything: also hides commands and edits
config_aparencia_pensamento_nada_aria: Nothing goes inside the thinking: every call stays visible in the conversation
config_aparencia_pensamento_busca_aria: Only search goes inside the thinking; Bash, Edit and Read stay visible
config_aparencia_pensamento_tudo_aria: Every call made between two thoughts goes inside the thinking
config_aparencia_grafico_desc: a table with a numeric column gets a button to turn into a bar chart — one column at a time
config_aparencia_leitura_desc: Automatic: the app decides from the photo. None: text straight over the photo. Text: boosts the letters only. Sheet: puts the conversation on an opaque sheet
config_aparencia_forca_leitura_desc: how much the boost (or the sheet) covers the photo: 0 lets it through, 100 covers it
config_aparencia_contraste_desc: makes the letters lighter over the photo, so they read better
config_aparencia_texto_conversa_desc: size, line height and column width — 100 is the default
config_aparencia_fonte_desc: the system one or a fixed-width one, like in the terminal
config_aparencia_paleta_desc: neutral gray with a single accent, or the usual warm indigo
config_aparencia_paleta_desktop: in the Desktop theme colors come from the wallpaper; switch theme to choose
config_aparencia_paleta_neutro_aria: Untinted gray, panels glued to the edge
config_aparencia_paineis_desc: the side panels, like the session context and this screen: floating as a box or glued to the edge
config_aparencia_nav_desc: vertical rail of initials, or tabs on top
config_aparencia_altura_desc: edge to edge, or shrunk to where the sessions end
config_aparencia_automatica_aria: Boosts text only when the background is an image
config_aparencia_texto_aria: No box: only the text gets contrast and shadow
config_aparencia_folha_aria: The whole conversation on an opaque sheet
config_aparencia_mono_aria: The fixed-width font, like in the terminal
config_aparencia_leve_aria: A light blur helps text over a very detailed photo
config_aparencia_forte_aria: The photo becomes a color smear — maximum reading relief
config_aparencia_desfoque_off_aria: The photo stays sharp behind the conversation, as it always was
config_aparencia_janela_aria: The window turns transparent and shows the real desktop
config_aparencia_vidro_aria: The app copies the system wallpaper into the page and gets glass
config_aparencia_caixa_solta_aria: Panels floating, with breathing room and rounded corners
config_aparencia_colados_aria: Panels glued to the screen edge, edge to edge
config_aparencia_altura_total_aria: The sidebar goes edge to edge on the screen
config_aparencia_so_conteudo_aria: The sidebar shrinks to the height of the sessions
config_aparencia_barra_lateral_aria: Collapsed, the sidebar becomes the vertical rail of initials
config_aparencia_abas_topo_aria: Collapsed, the sidebar becomes the horizontal tab strip on top
config_aparencia_chips_aria: One line with the argument in a chip
config_amostra_resposta: There. This is your conversation with the current tweaks — size, line height, contrast and how much the photo shows through the boxes.
config_ditado_desc: When it detects that you finished speaking, it stops recording, transcribes, and sends after 3 seconds. Click, tap, or press a key to cancel.
config_sobre_desc: Drive Claude Code, Codex and Pi sessions running on your computer — from your phone or desktop.
config_motores_nome_em_uso: A model with this name already exists. Pick another one, or edit the existing one.
config_motores_messages: — Claude Code builds the path itself. It must speak the Anthropic Messages API; an OpenAI-only gateway needs a translating proxy at 127.0.0.1. Public addresses must be https, or the key travels in plain text.
config_motores_chave_definida: key set — leave empty to keep
config_motores_colar_nova: paste a new key to replace
config_motores_endereco_mudou: You changed the address: to test a new address, paste the key too.
config_motores_testar_ids: Use "Test" above to list your provider ids.
config_motores_sem_visao: This model cannot see images: attaching a photo will not work.
config_motores_vazio_principal: empty = same as the main one
config_motores_subagentes_ajuda: Subagents do repetitive mechanical searching; a cheaper model here is real savings, without touching the session main model.
config_motores_janela_ajuda_1: Comes from the provider on test. Empty, Claude Code assumes 200k and compacts early even on a bigger model — wasted capacity. Check in the session with
config_motores_avancado_ajuda: Claude Code sends features only the Anthropic API understands; on a third-party provider they are refused or ignored. Each row already shows the verdict: open "why?" only if you want the reason.
config_motores_ligue_401: Turn on only if the provider returns 401 Missing API key

config_motores_sessoes_abertas: Sessions open on it keep running.
config_motores_sync_aviso: Saving also writes this key into Kimi, Pi and Codex, if they are installed.
config_motores_erro_sync: Model saved, but the key could not be published to the other agents
visor_nao_carregou: did not load — the file may have expired
config_diag_linha_desc: Download the usage record to send to whoever maintains the app
config_diag_regra_local: Stays on this machine — it leaves only when you download and send it.
config_diag_regra_sem_conversa: Stores no conversation, prompt, agent reply or API key.
config_diag_regra_rotativo: Keeps {dias} days; the oldest is deleted on its own.
config_server_valem: With the {etiqueta} label: applies to the chosen machine, immediately — no restart. No label: applies to this device only.
config_server_groq_ajuda: Authorizes the service that turns audio into text. Empty disables transcription.
config_server_transcription_endpoint_aju: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API. Empty uses the default service.
config_server_transcription_model_ajuda: Audio model offered by the selected service. Empty uses whisper-large-v3-turbo.
config_server_vocabulario_ajuda: Comma-separated. Use for project, session, client, and other non-Portuguese names. The app's own terms are already included.
config_server_guardar_ajuda: An attachment older than this is deleted on the next upload. 0 = never delete.
config_server_automacoes_ajuda: Master switch for what runs without you watching.
config_server_automacoes_porque: What the machine does on its own: chain the next task, resume a stalled session and sync Codex. Turn it off here to stop all of it at once.
config_server_pensamento_ajuda: Asks the API for a summary of the reasoning and shows it collapsed above the answer. New sessions only.
config_server_traduzir_pensamento_ajuda: Every reasoning block shown on screen becomes a provider call. Off, the text stays as it came.
config_server_avisar_terminar_ajuda: Notification when a long turn ends.
config_server_turno_curto_ajuda: Faster turns don't generate a notification.
config_server_marcar_travada_ajuda: A "working" session silent for longer than this gets the stuck warning.
notif_push_legenda: Turning alerts on applies to this device only — it is the browser that subscribes.
config_server_editor_ajuda: Binary that opens the session folder on the desktop (e.g. code, subl).
config_server_jev_chave_ajuda: typesafe.ai key. It is what enables `hangar-preview objetivo`, the loop where a small model navigates and fills a screen on its own in the built-in browser, one step at a time — without a key that verb does not exist, and the rest of the browser keeps working. Hangar injects it into the session environment, and only into sessions born with Jev on; in those, it is readable by whatever already runs inside them.
config_server_jev_padrao_ajuda: How a session starts when nobody picks — applies to the "New session" sheet, to hangar-send and to MCP. Ticking the switch on the sheet also updates this default.
config_server_jev_texto_endpoint_ajuda: Optional. OpenAI-compatible address for the small model that writes a field's value. Empty = use the local command.
config_server_jev_texto_chave_ajuda: Optional. The key for the endpoint above.
config_server_jev_texto_modelo_ajuda: Optional. Model name on the endpoint above.
config_server_jev_texto_cmd_ajuda: Optional. Local command that takes the request as an argument and prints only the value. Empty = the CLI's own default.
config_server_endpoint_llm_ajuda: Optional. Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible API that organizes the transcribed text. Empty uses the default service.
config_server_chave_llm_ajuda: Key for the service above. It is not the transcription key and does not unlock voices.
config_server_modelo_llm_ajuda: Model that adds punctuation, reorganizes, or builds the briefing. Empty uses Hangar's default model.
config_server_raciocinio_llm_porque: Default: sends nothing. none: turns reasoning off — cleanup has a time cap, and a model that thinks blows through it. low, medium and high ask for increasing reasoning, and only work on a provider that accepts this key.
config_server_raciocinio_llm_ajuda: How much the cleanup model may reason before answering.
config_server_elevenlabs_ajuda: Generates the voice that reads chat excerpts. Empty = read-aloud off.
config_server_confirmar_leitura_ajuda: Selections bigger than this ask for confirmation before generating audio. 0 = uses the 5000 default.
config_server_comando_voz_vered: Only with a voice reader installed
config_server_comando_voz_porque: Only touch this if you installed a voice reader on this machine yourself. Empty is the normal case: reading out loud then uses ElevenLabs.
config_server_comando_voz_ajuda: Optional. Program that takes text on stdin and returns WAV on stdout (e.g. Kokoro, piper). Empty = ElevenLabs only.
config_server_remocao_ao_salvar: Will be removed when you save.
config_escopo_sem_etiqueta: No label: applies to this device only.
config_escopo_mista: Both live here: with the {etiqueta} label the change goes to the server — including taking a server off its list. With no label, it applies to this device only.
config_server_chave_nao_volta: The key does not come back whole from the machine
config_server_voz_ajuda: Which voice from your account reads the text.
config_server_estabilidade_ajuda: A steadier voice reads the same from start to finish; a more emotional one varies the tone, and sometimes errs.
config_server_aderencia_ajuda: More faithful sticks to the original recorded voice; freer gives the model room to vary.
config_server_exagero_ajuda: Accentuates the voice's characteristic manner — past the point, speech gets exaggerated.
config_server_velocidade_ajuda: Adjusts the reading pace without changing the voice tone.
config_server_ouvir_amostra: 🔊 Hear a sample of this voice
config_server_ouca_antes: hear some excerpt first to compare voices with it
config_server_so_servidor_ajuda: The app only reads these: they are what this machine can do right now. They change on their own when the cause changes — a key set in Voice, an update, the service restarted.
config_server_raizes_ajuda: The folders the "New session" picker lists. Applies immediately, no Hangar restart.
config_server_raizes_vazio: No mapped folders — the New session picker will be empty.
config_server_versao: Running version (may differ from the one on disk until you restart)
config_server_env_ajuda: Everything only the machine's .env file changes. Read-only: to change any of it, edit the file and restart the service.
config_server_env_terminal: Which terminal program opens when you ask to open a folder in a terminal. Empty: the app picks one of the installed ones.
config_server_env_pricing_offline: On, cost is worked out from the price table shipped with the app only, without going to the internet. Figures can fall behind when a price changes.
config_server_env_claude_config_dirs: Hand-written list of the Claude accounts that show up in the app, as nickname:path separated by commas. Empty: the app finds accounts in your home folder on its own.
config_server_env_engines_file: Path to another models file, instead of the engines.json in the Claude folder. Use it to keep more than one set of models on the same machine.
config_server_env_codex_sync_enabled: Off (0), the machine never reconciles Codex on its own: not when a session opens, not through the Reconcile now button. Recommended: on.
config_server_env_auto_resume: On, and with Automations on, a session stopped by a usage limit goes back to work on its own when the limit lifts — provided something was left in its queue and the app can read the reopening time. Off, it waits for you.
config_server_env_omp_plugin_sync: On, the machine copies the catalogues and add-ons you use in Claude over to omp on its own, every so often. Off, nothing is copied.
config_server_env_omp_claude_context: On, omp also reads your Claude instructions (the CLAUDE.md file, both the global one and the project's) alongside its own. Off, it uses only its own.
config_server_env_lan_bind_ip: Network address the backend listens on. 127.0.0.1 = this machine only; its LAN IP lets the phone in from the same network.
config_server_env_port: Backend port — and the app's, when the backend serves the page. Changing it changes the address the phone and the desktop app use.
config_server_env_auth_token: Password the phone and the desktop app present to get in. It is what the pairing QR carries; changing it disconnects already-paired devices.
config_server_env_projects_dir: Folder where Claude Code writes the conversations (its `projects/`). Empty = the default folder of the account in use.
config_server_env_reload: Reloads the backend on every code edit. Development only: in normal use it drops open connections on every change.
config_server_env_diag_term_input: Logs the replies the terminal program sends back to the panel (never what you type). For tracking down characters that show up on their own in the Windows terminal; fills the log on a busy terminal.
config_server_env_front_port: Port where the app page is served, for the QR and the reach panel. Empty = the backend's own port; only a separate `vite preview` setup writes 5173 here.
config_server_env_public_url: Public address that replaces the automatically built one in pairing (QR and link). Use it when the app sits behind a domain or proxy.
config_server_env_server_id: This machine's name for the others: the id in peers.json and the reply address for messages between sessions. Empty = cross-machine messages off.
config_server_env_vapid_public: Public key of the phone's push notifications. The same pair on every machine, or each one asks for its own subscription. Empty = push off.
config_server_env_vapid_private: Private key of the push notification pair; goes with the public one above. Empty = push off.
config_server_env_vapid_subject: Contact (mailto:) that goes with the push key pair, required by the browser's notification service.
config_server_env_stall_poll_seconds: How often, in seconds, the watchdog looks for a stalled session (working with no sign of life for longer than the limit).
config_server_env_omp_plugin_sync_interv: Interval, in seconds, between two passes of the omp plugin import. Only applies with the import on.
config_server_env_sync: Sync of the machine list across devices. Turn it on here or in the Sync screen, which needs no restart.
config_server_env_sync_bootstrap: One-time secret asked at the first sync registration. Not used after that.
config_server_env_sync_data: Sync vault file (by default ~/.hangar/sync-vault.json). If it goes missing, the screen asks for a new registration.
config_server_env_sync_session_secret: Key that signs the sync session cookie. Empty, a new one is born on every restart and whoever was signed in has to sign in again.
config_server_env_sync_rate_max: How many failed sync sign-ins are accepted in the window before blocking.
config_server_env_sync_rate_window: Size of the window, in seconds, in which the failed attempts above are counted.
config_server_env_forwarded_allow_ips: Proxy IP the backend trusts to learn the real caller address and HTTPS. `*` trusts anyone — only if nothing reaches the port directly.
config_server_env_deploy_secret: Secret of the GitHub webhook that triggers the automatic deploy on a push to main. Empty = endpoint off.
config_server_env_alerta_codex_sync: It is off here, so it overrides the Codex automatic sync in Harnesses: turning that on has no effect while this variable is not back to 1. Automations off cancels it too.
config_servidores_sem_push: Notifications are not available in this browser.
maquinas_intro: A server is a computer with Hangar installed, where sessions run. This device shows the sessions of every server it knows, together in the list; servers registered with each other pass messages between their sessions.
maquinas_add_endereco_ajuda: IP or name, with a port if not the default — or the whole pairing link. E.g. 192.168.0.10, casa.ts.net
maquinas_add_token_ajuda: It is in the server's QR code, or in the {variavel} variable of its .env.
maquinas_add_falar_ajuda: Registers this server on the chosen one, and the chosen one on it, so sessions here and there can message each other. You can change it later.
maquinas_add_acompanhar_ajuda: Its sessions join this device's list. Off, the machine is kept for messages only.
maquinas_add_erro_nenhum: Pick at least one: show its sessions, or messages between sessions.
maquinas_add_erro_sem_identificador: The server answered without an identifier — set its CP_SERVER_ID and try again.
maquinas_add_erro_endereco: Invalid address — use an IP or a name, with a port if needed.
maquinas_secao_legenda: Tap a server to see its status, turn messages on or off, change the token or remove it.
maquinas_peer_desligado: Disabled on the server (enabled: false in peers.json) — out of the sweep, not tested.
maquinas_remover_aria: Remove {nome} from this device and from the server's registry
maquinas_remover_linha: Removed from this device and from the server's registry, here and there. Sessions stop exchanging messages with it; it can be added again by address.
maquinas_remover_linha_local: Removed from this device only: it is not in the server's registry. It can be added again by address.
maquinas_sem_identificador: It answers, but has no identifier — the name sessions use in the server::session address. Fill in the field below to enable messages.
maquinas_nao_responde: This device couldn't reach this machine, so it doesn't know its identifier — without it there are no messages between sessions with it.
maquinas_token_aparelho_recusado: This machine refused the token this device has for it, so its identifier can't be read. Change the token.
maquinas_volta_outra_maquina: This way answers. But the address {nome} stored for this machine ({endereco}) answers as “{outro}” — a different machine, and that is why messages don't come back. Fix the address below.
maquinas_ida_outra_maquina: The address stored here for {nome} ({endereco}) answers as “{outro}” — a different machine. Fix {nome}'s address.
maquinas_identificador_remoto_legenda: {nome}'s name for the other servers — the first half of the server::session address. Stored in its .env.
maquinas_so_no_servidor: The server already has its token, and that is what messages between sessions use. Only this app (desktop or phone) lacks it: enter the token to see its sessions here.
maquinas_volta_sem_medir: Messages from here reach it. Whether its messages reach here, this app can't check without its token.
maquinas_volta_sem_registro: This way answers, but the other side has not registered this server. Turning Messages between sessions on registers both ends.
maquinas_volta_token_recusado: The other side refused the token this device has for it. Change the token and the way back is measured again.
maquinas_vazio: No other servers yet — add the first one.
maquinas_buscar_nada: No new server with Hangar answering on Tailscale.
maquinas_buscar_achou: Found on Tailscale — only each one's token is missing:
maquinas_buscar_ajuda: Looks on the chosen server's Tailscale network for others with Hangar answering. Read-only: nothing joins the list until you add it.
maquinas_buscar_sem_maquina: Pick a server: the search runs on it, over its Tailscale network.
maquinas_remover_peer_lados: Sessions stop exchanging messages: the registration is removed here and there.
maquinas_remover_peer_so_aqui: The registration is removed here only — this device has no token for it to undo the other side.
maquinas_remover_peer_lado_de_la_falhou: Removed here. The other side did not undo the registration — remove it there if needed.
config_servidores_token_removido: The server leaves this device's list and the token stored here is erased.
config_servidores_token_removido_recado_: Its sessions stop showing on this device, and the token this browser kept is erased. Messages between sessions keep working: the server-side registration stays, with its token. To remove everything, use the line's ✕.
config_servidores_voltar: You will need the pairing token or QR to get back in.
config_servidores_aviso_ja_removido: This server was already removed on another device.
config_servidores_aviso_lista_mudou: The server list changed on another device — review before removing.
config_servidores_aviso_mudou: This server changed on another device — review before removing.
custos_recorte_parcial: the numbers at the top and the token-type breakdown are this filter. The panels below stay on the whole period: without the server's breakdown only the total of each dimension exists, not the cross between them.
custos_fora_periodo_1: 1 server responded outside the requested period and was left out of the sum
custos_fora_periodo: {n} servers responded outside the requested period and were left out of the sum
custos_recorte_vazio: No data for this filter — the filters don't overlap.
custos_sem_tarifa_volume: no known rate — only volume is measured
custos_do_bruto: {pct} of gross — the rest is cheap cache
custos_empilhado_por: Stacked by {modo}. Each column is a day.
custos_hover_detalhe: hover or tap a column for the day's detail
custos_tipo_token_conta: Measured tokens and estimated cost by type.
custos_modelo_gratis_nenhum_dolar: Free model — no dollar was spent.
custos_mesmos_tokens: The same tokens, if none were cache.
custos_quem_cobra: Account identified in history or model provider.
custos_qual_agente: Usage by CLI, including its sessions and subagents.
custos_onde_sessao: Where the session ran. Always the whole period of each machine — this cut comes from the total it answered, and it's the only one that also sees machines without a breakdown. Click to filter the rest of the screen.
custos_pasta_sessao: The folder where the session ran. Click to filter; the × removes it from the list without removing it from the bill.
custos_fora_da_lista: {n} out of the list ({valor}, still counting in the total):
custos_tirar_lista_conta: remove from the list (the spending still counts)
custos_com_tarifa: Base rate per million tokens and its source. Cost includes identified context surcharges. Click to filter.
custos_col_entrada_ajuda: left, everything fed to the model (uncached input + cache written + cache read); right, only the part that did not come from cache

codex_ui_importar_erro: The import failed. Details are in Settings → Harnesses.
codex_etapa_principal: Updating the main account before preparing this account…
codex_etapa_plugins: Checking and syncing plugins… this may take a little longer.
codex_ui_mcp_detalhe: Server {servidor}, variable {variavel}. It points at the other account's folder, so it was left out.
codex_ui_confianca_como: Codex itself approves hooks, on the first session opened in this account. The button below opens that session.
codex_ui_sem_pasta: No folder is allowed on this machine to open the session in.
lista_uso_skills: Spend and volume for skills, agents, tools, hooks and plugins
uso_aviso: Counts and costs come from the Claude Code transcript. Real cost only where usage is measured: skills (the responses of the run) and agents (the subagent transcript). Context size is estimated from characters (≈ 4 per token) and never becomes money.
uso_sec_skills_nota: Cost = responses between the skill call and the next skill or the next prompt. "you / model": how many you invoked with /skill and how many the model called on its own through the Skill tool.
uso_sec_bash_nota: First useful word of each command (skips cd, variables, sudo, timeout…).
uso_sec_agentes_nota: Real cost of each subagent transcript, linked to the call by the agent id. "asked / on its own" is an estimate: counts as asked when your prompt for that turn mentions an agent, subagent, parallel or Explore.
uso_sec_contexto_nota: What hooks, plugins, CLAUDE.md, the skill catalogue and reminders inject unasked. "≈ tok / session" is the average over the sessions where it appeared.
uso_sec_plugins_nota: Skills and hooks summed by plugin prefix.
uso_filtros: Filter by account, project, model or plugin
uso_graf_dia_nota: Calls and cost (skills + agents) per day. Click a table row to see that item only.
uso_graf_top_nota: Skills and agents with the highest real cost in the period.
uso_graf_ctx_nota: Average tokens (≈) injected into every session unasked, by category.
uso_sec_imagens_nota: Images you sent in prompts and images a tool read (Read on a PNG, browser screenshot). Tokens from pixels (width × height ÷ 750).
uso_sem_dias: no days with usage in this cut
uso_graf_bolhas_nota: Each bubble is a skill or an agent; size is the cost per call. The top-left corner is what to look for: rarely called and expensive.
uso_detalhe_sem_serie: no daily series in this cut
uso_resp_plugin_skills: Plugin with the largest skill presence in context
uso_resp_skill_contexto: Skill with the largest presence in context
uso_resp_plugin_agentes: Agent plugin with the highest estimated cost
uso_resp_agente_caro: Agent with the highest estimated cost
uso_legenda_peso: accumulated presence = skill text × responses it stayed in context for; this is an estimate, not spend
uso_legenda_vezes: times = how many times it was loaded
uso_grupo_nota: A skill without a plugin prefix goes into the group of the folder it came from: this repository, yours (~/.claude/skills), standalone installs (~/.agents/skills) or built into Claude Code/Codex (or already removed). Click a group to open or close it; click a skill to see its detail.
uso_ferr_nota: calls in the period · % of total
uso_sub_nota: Sorted by estimated API-rate cost; it does not directly represent subscription quota. Input, output, cache writes and cache reads stay separate, as on the Costs screen.
uso_cache_legado_nota: Older Codex rollouts may show zero cache writes because that detail was not recorded yet; costs in that history may be understated.
uso_graf_chamadas_dia_nota: Tools, skills, agents and images, Claude and Codex. Hover a day to see the number.
uso_graf_areas_nota: Real tokens of each turn (Claude and Codex), split across the areas of the files its tools touched, in proportion to the number of tools in each. A turn with no file counts as conversation. Per-project areas are edited in ~/.hangar/uso-areas.json.
custos_areas_sem_recorte: Provider, source and machine filters don't apply here.
custos_areas_erro: Couldn't read the areas from any machine.
uso_ocupados_nota: Size of the skill's text (and of its files read afterwards) × responses it stayed in context for, until the session ends or compacts. This measures accumulated presence, not spend: the provider may reuse that text from cache. Responses are exact; the token size is estimated (2.5 characters per token).
custos_aquecendo: {maquina}: first read of this machine's history in progress — this can take a few minutes.
custos_aquecendo_progresso: {maquina}: first read of the history — {lidos} of {total} transcripts. This can take a few minutes.
custos_filtros: Filter by account, project or model
custos_metodo_standard: Estimate using current Standard rates. Long-context pricing is applied per response for supported models. Fast mode and processing region are absent from the inspected records and are not included.
custos_aviso_estimativa: Tokens come from session history. Amounts use API rates and do not represent your Claude or ChatGPT bill.
custos_estimativa_incompleta: Partial estimate: {n} models have no rate. Their tokens count toward volume, but their cost is excluded.
custos_metodo_codex: In Codex, input includes cache: reused tokens are separated before applying rates. Reasoning is already part of output and is not counted twice.
custos_equivalente_metodo: Weights token types by each model’s input rate. This does not measure subscription quota.
